notes: Height and bulk sheet 10H (Oct. 1996). Double frame: a thin outer rule (~3 px, x ~92 on the left, y ~550 at the top) and a heavy inner rule (~9 px, x ~133-142, y ~591-600); the outline follows the inner edge of the heavy inner rule, the innermost one (rule 1); both rules and the paper between them are outside. The bottom edge sits just above the thick bar (~23 px) that rules off the full-width legend and title strip inside the heavy rule (rule 3; north arrow, scale bar, sheet number outside with it, so no remove polygon). No arcs, no other notches, no SECTION badge. 'SEE SHEET 8H', 'SEE SHEET 11H' and 'SEE SHEET 9H' float inside and stay inside (rule 4). No ink under the outline. Each side's inner edge was measured every 5 px along the side (the dark run of the rule in a 3-px band, runs wider than the rule's median width replaced by outer edge + median width), smoothed with a +-60 px running median, and the outline set ~2.5 px inside it (README rule 1), points every ~200 px; corners where straight fits of the last 300 px of the two sides meet. Every vertex checked on full-resolution close-ups.
